headline: Senate resolution that would have ended the April 2025 national emergency used to set global tariffs failed on April 30, 2025.
what_it_does: This resolution would have ended the national emergency President Trump declared on April 2, 2025. That emergency was used to put a 10% tariff on most goods coming into the United States. It was also used to add higher tariffs on goods from certain trading partners. Ending the emergency would have removed the legal basis for those tariffs.

who_it_affects.how: They would no longer have owed the 10% tariff and the extra country-specific tariffs set under this emergency.
Prices on imported goods could have been affected if the tariffs paid by importers were removed.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign trading partners named for extra duties
who_it_affects.how: Their exports to the US would no longer have faced the added tariffs set under this emergency.

who_it_affects.group: US producers that compete with imports
who_it_affects.how: They would have faced competition from imports no longer subject to these tariffs.
